name: 03 - Restaurant Accepts / Status Change

nodes.name: Supabase Webhook: orders update
nodes.notes: Configure as a Supabase Database Webhook on orders (UPDATE, column: status). See docs/n8n-webhook-setup.md.

nodes.name: Push Realtime Notification (placeholder)
nodes.notes: The customer order page (app/customer/orders/[id]/page.tsx) already polls orders.status directly every 3s, independent of this workflow -- this node is a placeholder for a push notification channel, not required for the customer to see the status change.

nodes.name: GET /api/internal/orders/:id/notification-details
nodes.notes: public.users has no email column (it lives on auth.users) and the webhook payload has no amount/address text, so this call fetches the confirmation email's content server-side.

nodes.name: Gmail: Send Order Accepted Email

parameters.subject: ={{"Your order from " + $json["restaurantName"] + " has been accepted!"}}
parameters.message:
={{"Good news -- " + $json["restaurantName"] + " has accepted your order #" + $json["orderId"].slice(0, 8) + ".

Amount: ₹" + $json["total"] + "
Delivery address: " + $json["deliveryAddress"] + "

We will let you know as your order moves through preparation and delivery."}}

nodes.notes: Credential intentionally left as a placeholder -- connect a real Gmail OAuth2 credential in the n8n UI (this node's Credential dropdown) before activating this workflow.
